StudyProfile.title: StudyProfile
StudyProfile.description: Synced Bible study progress, XP, completed missions, and verse reading checklist for an authenticated learner.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

completedMissions.description: Zero-indexed mission IDs completed by the learner (max 13).

quizBonusEarned.description: Zero-indexed mission IDs where perfect quiz bonus XP was awarded (max 13).

readVerses.description: Checked scripture reference keys in 'missionId-verseIdx' format (max 100).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the study profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest progress update.

MissionNote.title: MissionNote
MissionNote.description: Personal Mystery Challenge reflection note written for a specific study mission.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note author.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest note edit.

/studyProfiles/{userId}.description: Private study progress document owned by a single verified learner.

/studyProfiles/{userId}/notes/{missionId.description: Subcollection of personal reflection notes per mission owned by the parent profile owner.
